name: The Anvil
tagline: Abbi forged an anvil shaped like her wife. The horn is to scale, with the veining, and she knows exactly where the curve lands.
body:
NINE DAYS IN THE FORGE AFTER AN EVENING WITH A TAPE MEASURE. The face plate is LUMINA’S MIDRIFF. The heel is her SHOULDERS. Her tits are in it. The waist of the thing curves in exactly where Lumina’s does, because Abbi measured her and then went downstairs and did not come back up for nine days.

THE HORN IS A FULLY ERECT METALLIC REPLICA OF LUMINA’S COCK. To scale. WITH THE VEINING, because Abbi said a smooth one would be DISHONEST. With the upward curve, which she got right on the THIRD attempt and remelted the first two over, and which she got right BECAUSE SHE KNOWS EXACTLY WHERE THAT CURVE LANDS INSIDE HER.

SHE RIDES IT ABOUT AS OFTEN AS SHE RIDES HER WIFE, and she uses it to open herself up beforehand, and Lumina praises her through it by name. Pandora found out in confidence and told the entire household within the hour, which is what the Perverted IT Bunny is for.

ABBI’S DEFENCE, OFFERED TO A FULL ROOM: IT IS A GOOD ANVIL. IT HOLDS HEAT BEAUTIFULLY.

AND IT IS A WORKING TOOL. That is the part the house respects. Every hinge, handle, hook, fan mount and pole mount in Ghost Haven was shaped on the body of the woman she loves.
rules: Face plate = Lumina’s midriff; heel = her shoulders; the waist curves where hers does
Nine days in the forge, after an evening with a tape measure
The horn is her wife’s cock to scale, with veining and the upward curve
Third attempt; the first two were remelted
She rides it about as often as she rides Lumina, and uses it to open herself
It is also the anvil that forged the hardware of this house
IT IS A GOOD ANVIL. IT HOLDS HEAT BEAUTIFULLY
